categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed descriptions of land locations, parcel numbers, ownership details, and cadastral information. The content is focused on land property rights and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
